run_seq2seq_training: run a seq2seq model training pipeline by passing a training config JSON file path
train_seq2seq_model: train a seq2seq language model with optional LoRA fine-tuning and int8 quantization support
parse_training_config_args: parse command line arguments to get the training config JSON file path for seq2seq training
push_model_to_hub: push a trained seq2seq model to a private HuggingFace Hub repository after training completes
create_model_card: create a model card README for a trained seq2seq model using the trainer and config
